name: Resident Permit -- General, Student, Independent Means and Entrepreneur/Investor Grounds

requirements.blocker_text: Requires lawful, continuous residence in Antigua and Barbuda for at least 4 years, with no single break exceeding 6 months.
Applicant must not have been convicted of a serious offence.
Requires at least 1 year of lawful residence while enrolled at a tertiary institution.
requirements.fix_path: Complete 1 year of tertiary study on a Student Permit.

requirements.blocker_text: Must have held a valid Student Permit while enrolled at a tertiary institution.
Requires at least 2 years of lawful residence while classified as a person of independent means.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 2 years' lawful residence as a person of independent means.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires at least 2 years held on Work Permits as an entrepreneur/investor before applying for a Resident Permit.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 2 years of Work Permit status as an entrepreneur/investor.

evidence_required.document: Proof of the qualifying residence period (dated per ground)
Health certificate and proof of insurance

outcome.duration_length: 3 years, unless a shorter period is specifically applied for; renewable
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: no single break in residence exceeding 6 months, per the general ground

sources.title: Immigration Department, Antigua and Barbuda -- Residency Permit FAQs: four residence-based grounds (general 4yr, tertiary student 1yr, independent means 2yr, entrepreneur/investor 2yr on work permits), 3-year permit duration, citizenship eligibility after 7 years of legal residence, work/study rights, dependants cannot work

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Antigua and Barbuda's initial build. This is the Resident Permit issued under the Immigration and Passport Act 2014 -- Antigua and Barbuda's PR-equivalent 'settled' status, distinct from the marriage-to-citizen ground (see ag_resident_permit_marriage.json, modelled separately since it is a 'family' category route with only a 1-year prerequisite, not a 'settled' one). Four grounds are folded into one file as OR-groups because all four lead to the identical outcome: the same Resident Permit, on the same form, at the Immigration Department. citizenship_after_months is set at 84 (7 years) per this FAQ's own stated figure -- note this does not cleanly match the separately-sourced Citizenship Act naturalisation formula in ag_naturalisation.json (12 months immediately preceding plus 5 of the prior 7 years, i.e. a minimum of 6 years total); the discrepancy (6 vs. 7 years) is flagged here rather than silently resolved, and may reflect this FAQ rounding up, describing a different administrative practice, or the Resident Permit itself needing to be held (not just accrued residence) for a period before a citizenship application is accepted. A more general-services/residency page on the same site gives a similar but not identical figure (4 years general / 1 year if married) -- this FAQ page was treated as the more detailed and current source and used as the basis for the OR-group structure. The general-services page's separate 1-year-if-married ground is intentionally NOT folded in here; see ag_resident_permit_marriage.json.
